prompt: Review whether Planet Labs has a material causal relationship to defense and aerospace demand through government imagery, monitoring and dedicated tasking; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Government defense and security demand for persistent imagery, monitoring and dedicated tasking can convert appropriated budgets into Planet contract value, backlog, revenue and cash flow, subject to funding, cancellation and satellite-delivery risk.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if defense exposure is immaterial, awards are cancelled or unfunded, contract visibility fails to convert to revenue, or satellite and launch execution prevents delivery.
